title: How do datasets, developers, and models affect biases in a low-resourced language?

bias_targets.methodology: Conducting an algorithmic audit by comparing sentiment classifications and numerical sentiment scores of fine-tuned language models (mBERT and BanglaBERT) using pairs of identical Bengali sentences that explicitly or implicitly (e.g., via kinship terms) represent female versus male identities.

Conducting an algorithmic audit by comparing sentiment classifications and numerical sentiment scores of fine-tuned language models using pairs of identical Bengali sentences that explicitly or implicitly (e.g., via community-specific vocabularies like Sanskrit-derived vs. Perso-Arabic words) represent Hindu versus Muslim identities.

Conducting an algorithmic audit by comparing sentiment classifications and numerical sentiment scores of fine-tuned language models using pairs of identical Bengali sentences that explicitly or implicitly (e.g., via Bangal versus Ghoti dialects) represent Bangladeshi versus Indian Bengali identities.
